notes: Design package 7.3. The v2 template extends a hero's approved v1 deformation rig in place: every v1 bone keeps its rest transform (so the approved bone-heat weights stay valid) and the new bones take their weights by deterministic, rule-based carving from their parent's weights. Built in memory at bake time from the pinned packed source; the source blend is never saved. Controls (IK hands and feet, poles, aim_ctrl, support_ctrl) are authoring-only: the clip library solves them analytically and bakes plain FK bases, so no constraint ever evaluates at render time.

weaponSocket.note: Package 7.3 moves the weapon socket from forearm.R to hand.R. The approved Commando v1 rig already parents weapon_socket to hand.R, so v2 keeps it there and records the fact.

fingers.note: Tripo meshes have fused fingers (decision 24: no hero-mesh regeneration). The four fingers share the grip_01-03 mitten curl; thumb and index bones exist for sockets and future meshes but carve no weight on a fused mesh.

springChains.note: Per-hero baked spring chains need a per-mesh cloth/strap segmentation; none of the Commando's approved layers carries a free strap mesh, so v2 bakes without one.
